ns2:section.sectionText: Departmental approval required, contact Rebecca Hodson (iSchool Career Services) at rhodson1@illinois.edu. This zero-credit course is for students who have been offered a full-time internship or co-op that is related to their major field of study. A brief reflection is required to receive the Satisfactory grade. For international students, this course can be used for Curricular Practical Training (CPT).
